Please solve this issue:

## Bug Description

The internal counter (cq_count) used to track RTIO completion queue events is only ever incremented and never decreases. This counter is used by rtio_submit() to determine when a submission has completed.

A typical RTIO I2C transaction produces 2 CQE events. At 50 I2C transactions per second, cq_count overflows in ~250 days (2^31 / 50 / 2 / 86400). At overflow, the wait loop in rtio_submit() either exits immediately or loops forever, depending on signedness:

  cq_count = INT32_MAX + 1;  // wraps to INT32_MIN
  while (INT32_MIN < target) { ... }  // wrong behavior

This affects the non-semaphore code path (CONFIG_RTIO_SUBMIT_SEM=n). The cq_count overflow is not properly handled — it should either be detected and dealt with, or the increment should use well-defined unsigned wrapping.

The bug is in include/zephyr/rtio/rtio.h in the rtio_cqe_submit() and z_impl_rtio_submit() functions.

See: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/81802
